wrap_multiagent_env_dict_keys: wrap a list-indexed multiagent dm_env environment to use dict-indexed observations and actions
convert_list_to_dict: convert a list of agent observations into a dict keyed by string agent indices
convert_dict_to_list: convert a dict of agent actions keyed by string indices back into a list
step_wrapped_env: step the wrapped multiagent environment with dict-indexed actions and get dict-indexed timesteps
get_observation_spec_dict: get the dict-indexed observation spec from a wrapped multiagent environment
